findings.detail: Cookie 'JSESSIONID' lacks HttpOnly. Sensitive cookie — JavaScript can read this via document.cookie (XSS escalation risk).
Cookie 'JSESSIONID' is explicitly cross-site (SameSite=None; Secure). Verify this is intentional — third-party/embed use case only.
Cookie 'JSESSIONID' has Domain='.www.linkedin.com' (leading dot). Cookie is sent to all subdomains. If a subdomain is compromised, attacker can read/set this cookie.
Cookie 'JSESSIONID' has no Expires/Max-Age — it's a session cookie. Deleted when browser closes. Acceptable for auth cookies; risky if user keeps browser open indefinitely.
